tips.qcraft.field_guide: With Patchouli installed, combine a Book and Quantum Dust to make the qCraft Field Guide.
tips.qcraft.mine_quantum_ore: Bring an iron pickaxe or better for Quantum Ore. Look below Y=16 in stone and near the bottom of the Overworld in deepslate.
tips.qcraft.ore_enchantments: Fortune can yield extra Quantum Dust. Silk Touch gives you the ore block instead.
tips.qcraft.face_recipe: Put an essence in the center of the crafting grid. Leave the top-right and bottom-right slots empty. Any empty face slot counts as air.
tips.qcraft.face_directions: Hover over a qBlock to check its six faces. North is world north. Your crafting table has no opinion on the matter.
tips.qcraft.witness_statements: Give an Observer-Dependent Block gold on the north and stone on the south. Observe from each side in turn, then write two conflicting witness statements.
tips.qcraft.let_go: Back away and look well clear to reset a qBlock. If it stays put, check for another observer. This includes the friend who said they were helping.
tips.qcraft.opposite_faces: A Quantum Block picks between opposite faces on the axis you observe from. Three repeats in a row are still three rolls.
tips.qcraft.secret_door: Give an Observer-Dependent Block a solid face on one side and air on the other for a secret door. Test it alone. An audience can hold the wall in place.
tips.qcraft.hidden_machines: A standalone machine pauses when its qBlock face is hidden. A powered Automated Observer can keep that face open while it runs.
tips.qcraft.filing_system: Two chest faces on one qBlock have separate inventories. If you filed the diamonds under East, try looking from the east.
tips.qcraft.matching_pairs: Put an Essence of Entanglement between matching qBlocks or Quantum Computers. Hover over both results to check their shared frequency.
tips.qcraft.unloaded_partner: An entangled qBlock can wait for its partner's chunk to load. Entanglement does not load chunks.
tips.qcraft.observer_input: Place an Automated Observer directly beside a qBlock. Feed it redstone from the side opposite the qBlock.
tips.qcraft.retire_the_chickens: Put stone and a Block of Redstone on opposite faces of a Quantum Block for a random lamp circuit. The chickens can take the rest of the day off.
tips.qcraft.reroll: Switch an Automated Observer off and let the qBlock go inert before the next pulse. Stand back or equip Anti-Observation Goggles.
tips.qcraft.goggles: Equip Anti-Observation Goggles in the Curios Goggles slot to build around qBlocks without observing them yourself.
tips.qcraft.pylon_alignment: Build four pylons of equal height around each Quantum Computer. Point each gold face inward and copy the offsets at the other station.
tips.qcraft.coolant: A successful Quantum Computer swap uses one coolant charge. Craft a used Coolant Cell with Blue Ice to refill it.
tips.qcraft.moving_day: Keep chests and machines outside a Quantum Computer's swap area. The computer would rather cancel the move than pack your boxes.
